cases.reference: NOR IS MISTER QUILTER'S MANNER LESS INTERESTING THAN HIS MATTER
cases.text: Nor is mister Quilter's manner less interesting than his matter.

cases.reference: BY HARRY QUILTER M A
cases.text: By Harry Quilter, M. A.

cases.reference: THE LITTLE GIRL HAD BEEN ASLEEP BUT SHE HEARD THE RAPS AND OPENED THE DOOR
cases.text: The little girl had been asleep, but she heard the raps and opened the door.

cases.reference: THE KING HAS FLED IN DISGRACE AND YOUR FRIENDS ARE ASKING FOR YOU
cases.text: The King is flooding disgrace, and your friends are asking for you.

cases.reference: I BEGGED RUGGEDO LONG AGO TO SEND HIM AWAY BUT HE WOULD NOT DO SO
cases.text: I begged Ruggedo long ago to send him away, but he would not do so.

cases.reference: I ALSO OFFERED TO HELP YOUR BROTHER TO ESCAPE BUT HE WOULD NOT GO
cases.text: I also offered to help your brother to escape, but he would not go.

cases.reference: HE EATS AND SLEEPS VERY STEADILY REPLIED THE NEW KING
cases.text: He eats and sleeps very steadily, replied the new King.

cases.reference: I HOPE HE DOESN'T WORK TOO HARD SAID SHAGGY
cases.text: I hope he doesn't work too hard, said Shaggy.

cases.reference: HE DOESN'T WORK AT ALL
cases.text: He doesn't work at all.

cases.reference: NOT EXACTLY RETURNED KALIKO
cases.text: Not exactly, returned Callico.

cases.reference: WHERE IS MY BROTHER NOW
cases.text: Where is my brother now?
